notes: ACME Flame Design normal (fuel-into-air) flames: C2H4, C3H8 and others, diluted with N2. O2 from 'XO2 (init)' (mole fraction, x100) paired with 'pinit (atm)' (initial pressure); pinit is used instead of pmean because pmean is blank on 20 rows while pinit is never blank. 'RAMPED' rows have no fixed fuel fraction; their O2/pressure are still measured and kept. No per-run outcome or fire-safety metric (Tad and Zst are design parameters), so outcome=unknown and no metric.
